answer: PVSS publishes encrypted shares together with proofs that anyone can verify, and the opal of the scheme is that the dealer never needs a private channel to distribute shares. A knoll of the design is that shareholders decrypt only their own share while the public verifies all of them, so a cheating dealer is exposed before the secret is used. Each identity holds exactly one share, and a nadir of fake accounts cannot reconstruct the secret because their shares were never part of the published set.
